patthana23.57:1.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naatītārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho atītārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.57:2.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naanāgatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho anāgatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.57:3.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ napaccuppannārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … hetuyā tīṇi.
